sentences.text: DEEP WATER TOOLING AS is registered under industry code 77.340 (Utleie og leasing av sjøtransportmateriell).

Statutory purpose (registry): “Bygging og tilpasning av verktøy og utstyr til offshorenæring for salg eller utleie og annet som naturlig faller sammen med dette, samt deltagelse i andre selskaper med lignende virksomhet.”
Registered activity (registry): “Utleie av utstyr til offshore, utleie av ROV system offshore.”

The company's verified website describes it as: “Our team has more than 100 years combined experience from ROV and diving operations within oil and gas projects, research and salvage operations all over the world.” (self-reported).
It was incorporated (stiftelsesdato) on 2021-03-20, about 5 years ago.
Legal form: AS.
Chief executive (daglig leder): Jonas Claes-Åke Broberg.
Board chair: Kai Roger Loven.
The registered board has 5 member(s); the board registration was last changed on 2025-02-14.
Registered auditor: CEDRA NORGE AS.
Registered accountant: AIDER AS.
Registered business address: Kyrkjebakken 26, 6856 SOGNDAL (SOGNDAL).
1 registered workplace(s) in SOGNDAL; a total workplace headcount is not established because some counts are missing.
For 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (company accounts): revenue NOK 10.8 million (10 774 169); operating result NOK 2.4 million (2 445 792); annual result NOK 1.5 million (1 522 572).
Balance sheet at 2025-12-31 (company accounts): equity NOK 4.7 million (4 691 609); total assets NOK 5.9 million (5 885 733); total debt NOK 1.2 million (1 194 124).
Calculated equity ratio at 2025-12-31 (company accounts): 79.7% (equity divided by total assets, from the filed figures).
Calculated operating margin for 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (company accounts): 22.7% (operating result divided by revenue).
Annual accounts are on file for 5 year(s), 2021–2025.

For 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (company accounts), the company recorded an operating profit and an annual profit. These are filed accounting results for that period; they do not establish current cash flow.
Revenue increased by NOK 5 852 695 (+118.9%): NOK 4 921 474 in 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31 to NOK 10 774 169 in 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (company accounts; calculated from comparable annual periods).

Verified official website: https://dwt.no/.
How it was verified: the site names the company and shows its registered address.
Company-linked profiles: LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/deep-water-tooling-as).
Contact details published on the verified website: info@dwt.no.

sentences.text: AUTORINGEN AS is registered under industry code 82.990 (Annen forretningsmessig tjenesteyting ikke nevnt annet sted).

Statutory purpose (registry): “Kjøp og salg av biler, auksjonsvirksomhet, meglingsvirksomhet, tilby tjenester tilknyttet bilsalg samt det som naturlig faller sammen med dette, herunder å delta i andre selskaper med lignenede virksomhet og yte konsulentbistand. Selskapet skal primært drive sin virksomhet innen bilbransjen.”

Registered activity (registry): “Kjøp og salg av biler, auksjonsvirksomhet, bilmegling, tjenesteyting tilknyttet bilsalg samt det som naturlig faller sammen med dette, herunder å delta i andre selskaper med lignenede virksomhet og yte konsulentbistand. Selskapet skal primært drive sin virksomhet innen bilbransjen.”

The company's verified website describes it as: “Velkommen til Autoringen - din ledende B2B bilauksjon i Norge. Autoringen – ditt førstevalg for B2B bilauksjoner og bilsalg. Vi tilbyr en omfattende plattform for auksjoner, med fokus på B2B salg av biler.” (self-reported).
The official registry reports 9 employees.

Board chair: Finn Jentoft.
The registered board has 7 member(s); the board registration was last changed on 2025-01-17.

Registered business address: Bølerveien 77, 2020 SKEDSMOKORSET (LILLESTRØM).
1 registered workplace(s) in LILLESTRØM, with 9 registered employees across them.
